subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF CZECH
text:
U1452/26 NOTAMR U0955/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2610250535 C)2701252359 EST
E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF CZECH
REPUBLIC AS TO ALL ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE
CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND ALL OPERATORS
HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION
AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF
CZECH REPUBLIC (AS PER AIP SUP 16/22), AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY NOTIFY THAT ALL ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED,
OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF CZECH REPUBLIC OR
BY ANY OPERATOR HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFCIATE (AOC) ISSUED BY
AUTHORITIES OF CZECH REPUBLIC ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT AND
OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXC FOR ACFT IN EMERGENCY
SITUATION AND FLIGHTS OPERATED UNDER SPECIAL PERMISSION GRANTED BY
FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS APPROPRIATE.
